BiblicalUsage: Sebat is the eleventh month, and it appears once, as a date: upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah. The month matters because the word came on a known day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God speaks on ordinary days in named months, for the word came on the twenty-fourth day of Sebat, and that is how I know He deals with real people in real time.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
